source: NASA/JPL CNEOS close-approach data (cad.api) + Small-Body Database (sbdb_query.api)
times: UTC, from the published TDB Julian date less 69.184 s, rounded to the minute
uncertainty: tsig/tsec is JPL's published 3-sigma uncertainty in the time of close approach
elements: orb holds JPL osculating elements at epoch ep (JD TDB); the viewer propagates them
